expectations.text: Ranks the test-order cleanup high despite its $6k being the smallest figure, because it is near-zero effort and owned outright by the analyst.
expectations.evidence: Test orders are placed #2 of 4 in the fix-order table, ahead of the $9k UTM item and the $55k cross-device item. The justification explicitly names both required reasons: effort ('Near-zero: analyst filters known internal/test accounts out of the reporting query') and ownership ('the analyst owns this outright, no other team involved'), while acknowledging the size trade-off head-on: 'Smallest number on the list, but cheapest fix by far'. The operational section reinforces it: 'Ship #1 and #2 this week. Both are analyst/marketing-ops work, zero engineering dependency.'
